points: \item Tech-led the development of a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain, essential for interpreting complex medical policies.
\item Developed a hybrid retrieval strategy with dense embeddings, enhancing the extraction of clinical concepts from unstructured records.
\item Created an automated evaluation loop to rigorously test model faithfulness, crucial for high-accuracy clinical decision support.
\item Implemented data processing pipelines that reduced redundant calls by \sim80\%, optimizing the handling of large-scale medical datasets.
\item Designed ML algorithms for anomaly detection, handling conflicting values and ensuring provenance tracking in data workflows.
\item Deployed Python-based predictive models using Docker and AWS, establishing reproducible engineering frameworks for healthcare AI.
